# Xcode Project Setup (Firebase)

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — safely modifies Xcode projects to add Swift Packages and link files: runs the bundled `xcode_spm_setup` Swift script (idempotent) instead of hand-editing `.pbxproj`, with an explicit anti-Ruby mandate (no Ruby, no `xcodeproj` gem — Swift only, Node/TypeScript as last resort), modern folder synchronization instead of manual `.pbxproj` edits, toolchain verification (`swift --version` first), mandatory `-ObjC` linker flags for static Firebase frameworks, always-latest Firebase iOS SDK version resolution, and an empty-directory workflow that asks the user to create the `.xcodeproj` first. Requires macOS with Xcode/Swift; the Firebase iOS SDK it configures is Google's paid platform beyond the free allowance — a paid service for real projects. By @firebase, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
